Description:
The mask slips and the ghoul shows through. This Ken Kaneki hoodie pulls the most haunting frame in Tokyo Ghoul straight onto your chest: one calm human eye, one blood-red kakugan, framed in stark manga ink. Japanese kanji streaks down both sleeves while a brooding side-profile of Kaneki anchors the back print, so every angle reads loud and unmistakable.

Cut as an unisex streetwear pullover with a brushed-fleece interior, it keeps the warmth in and the silhouette clean. Choose your fabric weight and size, then build it into your everyday rotation. Fan-made and anime-inspired, not affiliated with or endorsed by the official Tokyo Ghoul license.
